description: Review code 100X faster. Lens draws every PR as animated architecture and data-flow walkthroughs, inside the pull request itself. Use it as a GitHub App, GitHub Action, CLI, or a Skill for your coding agent
summary: PR Lens posts an animated architecture and data-flow diagram as a comment on the PR itself, so I can see blast radius and payload shapes without scrolling through a 400-line diff. The fact that it ships as a GitHub App, a CLI, and a Skill for coding agents means I can drop it into PenguPool sessions when an agent is reviewing a change and needs spatial context about the codebase. It's the kind of tool that removes a real layer of review toil without asking me to adopt another IDE plugin or dashboard.
